notes: The commands now have no memory or time limit. Older runs below that report memory-limit were stopped at 5.25 GiB. See diagnosis.json for completed runs without limits.
The scenario is compiled. It is not executed.
Memory values are samples from the compiler process for the scenario crate. They exclude dependency compiler processes.
Short peaks can occur between samples. The JSONL files also contain the process peak commit counters.
Elapsed times include dependency compilation. These are not isolated speed benchmarks.
The memory limit stops the launched process tree. A stopped run has no policy verdict.
The anchor field is not read by the IRQ loop. Its effect on analysis memory is the reason it remains in the source.
The helper returns its input pointer at runtime. Its crate is excluded from analysis, so the checker cannot use that body to resolve the returned pointer.
The controls without the field and without the walk used an earlier version with an empty Serial type in place of (). Each evidence directory contains its source snapshot.
No checker implementation was changed for these runs. The exact cause of the kernel failure is not established.
